Edgar Wallace, Room 13.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/edgar-wallace/room-13

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Edgar Wallace, the author, died 1932.

First publication of the text used: 1924 (SE colophon: 'Room 13 was published in 1924 by Edgar Wallace.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1924, before 1931, so it is in the public domain in the United States.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa, and each has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die died in 1932, so the text is public domain in each of these countries from 1 January 2003 at the latest.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
